title: Small Savings Interest Rates Frozen for Q4 FY26
summary: Government keeps small savings rates unchanged for Jan-Mar 2026; Sukanya Samriddhi and SCSS lead at 8.2%.

blocks.content: Government maintained small savings rates unchanged for Q4 FY26. **Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana and SCSS offer 8.2%**, PPF offers 7.1%, NSC offers 7.7%, and KVP offers 7.5%.

items: **Review Committee**: Rates determined per G-Sec yield formula set by Shyamala Gopinath Committee.
